title: Law to let people sue AI companies for third-party misuse harm
summary: This bill would let a person sue an artificial intelligence company when a third party misuses its AI model and causes foreseeable harm in New York City, if the company failed to put in place reasonable safeguards against that misuse. Remedies could include damages, punitive damages and injunctive relief. It is one of several AI-related bills heard by the Committee of the Whole on October 5, 2026.
